data.one_liner: A tab bar view widget where each tab's height automatically adjusts to fit its content.
data.what_it_does: Combines autoscale_tabbarview and expandable_page_view functionalities to provide a ContentSizeTabBarView widget. It allows creating a tab bar view whose height automatically resizes to fit its content, fixing issues found in release mode when nested inside scroll views.
use_when: You need a TabBarView that dynamically resizes its height based on the current tab's content.
You experience layout or sizing issues with AutoScaleTabBarView inside a CustomScrollView or SingleChildScrollView in release mode.
avoid_when: You do not need automatic height adjustments for tabs.
strengths: Automatically adjusts height to fit tab content
Works inside scroll views where other auto-scaling tab views fail in release mode
Smooth tab switching animations with TabController integration
weaknesses: Limited documentation and community usage beyond the basic example
